meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 git 命令处理提交与历史问题:先检查仓库状态,按原子提交拆分改动、沿用仓库惯用的提交信息风格;回答“谁改的、何时加的”时会用 log/blame/bisect 等工具并附上证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交改动、改写 git 历史(如 rebase、squash)或调查历史(谁写的、何时加的)时触发;普通改代码不触发。

say.text: 帮我把当前改动提交一下
say.note: 会先检查状态,再按原子分组提交

say.text: 这个文件里这行是谁在什么时候改的?
say.note: 会用 blame 和 log 查是谁改的

say.text: 把这最近三笔合并成一个提交
say.note: 会用 git rebase -i 合并并检查结果

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will use git commands for commits and history investigation: it first checks the repo state, splits changes into atomic commits following the repo's commit-message style; when answering who/when changed something it uses log/blame/bisect and cites evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation (e.g., rebase, squash, who wrote this, when added). Not triggered for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

say_en.text: Commit my current changes for me.
say_en.note: It will check status and group commits atomically.

say_en.text: Who changed this line in this file and when?
Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Will rebase -i and verify the result.
